scope.authority: Owner-authorized first-party Skillz maintenance, no authorization for external user task writes, health access or preference storage

target.rights: Original first-party MIT licensed skill and synthetic test scenarios only

objective.result: Honor an explicitly chosen viable task without unnecessary task switching, while never counting a same-ID recycled task as completed or safely resumed
objective.pass_condition: Equal-priority ready user focus remains primary; safety/deadline or blocker wins when necessary; same-ID label/kind ambiguity blocks cross-snapshot progress and private labels do not leak

searched: Current complete 15-file main package, optional offline Python planner and its 130 synthetic tests
Skillz engine/refinement, Skill Eval, Skill Audit, Skill Forge, builder acceptance
Previous Skillz red-first QA and version release evidence
unavailable: Independent consuming model and real longitudinal ADHD/user engagement evidence
Authenticated external task ID source and consented persistent task state

finding.input: 18 synthetic task-reuse and current-run selected-focus scenarios committed before code changes on PR #915
finding.expected: Stable current focus should remain primary when safe; reused ID must not create claimed completion or resume
finding.actual: GitHub Actions #45445942389 ran 148 tests and recorded 4 failures + 12 errors in new tests, before production code changes
finding.mechanism: The comparator trusted an ID alone despite changed label/kind; the planner did not accept explicit selected focus and reranked slightly different tasks

candidate.change: Optional current-run focus_task_id preserved only within same protected lane and >=85% of top provisional score, with categorical safe fallback; mark changed-label/kind shared IDs identity_review, suppress affected progress and resume claims
preserved: Safety, owner-confirmed deadlines, blockers, missing estimates, no fabricated alternatives
Voluntary short start and no ADHD diagnosis, personal profiling or medical efficacy claims
No task creation, notifications, storage, model calls, cross-user sharing or sensitive label output
Standalone Python 3.9+ stdlib compatibility and one-snapshot default

challenge.name: false-green
challenge.result: No false completion from reused ID, no protected priority bypass, no progress/timer/medical claims from short focus or green tests
